name: Rack Packer
tagline: Sokoban with GPUs: cool them, belt them, rack them.
description: Bufo installs GPU cards by pushing them into empty rack slots. Hot cards must slide through a coolant puddle first or the rack goes up in flames, and Mistral-logo conveyor belts whisk cards across the datacenter one tile per tick.
win_text: Every rack is full. Ship it!
lose_text: You racked a hot GPU. Fire in aisle three!
